text:
alex: Quick PSA: after the payment-units serialization rollout (v2), invoice-preview latency up ~40-60ms for small requests. Dashboards show sampling drift for low-volume tenants. Can someone sanity-check?

maria: I see the spike too in staging. Might be extra decode step in serializer. Rolling back? :thinking_face:

kevin: Noticed a surge in event size too — payload size +15%. serializer now emits 'payment_units' array instead of compact blob.

sophie: @kevin can you paste example? I want to check ingest parsers.

kevin: Here's a reduced sample:
```
{"tenant_id":"t-123","units":[{"type":"token","count":12}],"meta":{"src":"edge"}}
```
Previously we stored hex blob `pu:v1:...`.

alex: That's the change. Router + metering consumer assume v1 compact for quick parsing and sampling. New shape causes additional JSON.parse and nested loops.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout-payment-serializer v2 completed to prod at 2025-11-18T03:10Z

maria: Can we change consumer to read both shapes? I'd prefer a hotfix to avoid rollback.

james: We can add a fast-path: if payload has `units` array, transform to flattened counters before sampling. Patch ready, can ship to canary.

kevin: Also seeing invoice-preview aggregation code assumes deterministic ordering of keys. v2 adds meta order variability => sampling buckets drift.

sophie: Patch idea from james looks good. Suggest a small unit test that simulates both ordering and sizes. Also add telemetry tag `pu_shape` for reconciliation.

alex: :thumbsup: james, can you open a quick PR and flag for oncall review? We should also add a console note in dashboard about sampling change.

james: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/meters/pull/419 — added fast-path + pu_shape telemetry. Will canary to 10% tonight.

maria: If canary ok, schedule rollout window 03:00-06:00 UTC and keep invoice-preview cache TTL short for 1 hour.

alex: Thanks all. Follow-ups: (1) ops to monitor delta in token counts per-tenant (2) product to be aware minor invoice-preview jitter (3) SLO: keep preview p95 within +20ms baseline. I'll post summary in #eng-platform later.
